items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Kingfish was the bartender. He's alive, thank God.

ctx.x: Kingfish was the bartender. He's alive, thank God. Coleman Hawkins got a full glass of whiskey because Herschel played that night. This is the great night that's in the book of "Hear Me Talking to You". Ben said, "Kitten, come down here," and they weren't trying to outplay Hawk. They were just glad that Hawk was there, but Hawkins had never been challenged like this. He had never sit around with saxophone players like this.
With Herschel? Where was Herschel from, by the way?
